title: Microsoft Advertising Campaign Management v13: POST https://campaign.api.bingads.microsoft.com/CampaignManagement/v13/OnlineConversionAdjustments/Apply
description: Transcribed from learn.microsoft.com/en-us/advertising/campaign-management-service/onlineconversionadjustment and applyonlineconversionadjustments (view=bingads-13, fetched 2026-09-29). Headers CustomerId and CustomerAccountId are non-secret; Authorization (Bearer) and DeveloperToken are added by the live transport. The per-request maximum for ONLINE adjustments is undocumented; the offline equivalent allows 1,000.

ConversionName.description: 'must match an existing conversion goal name'

allOf.description: AdjustmentValue: 'Required if AdjustmentType is set to "Restate", and otherwise this field should not be set.'
